title: Trust Mechanisms for Offline Generative AI at the Edge: A Connectivity-Regime Framework and an Empirical Study on a Raspberry Pi 5
abstract: arXiv:2610.33732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI and large language models (LLMs) are moving into the Internet of Things, yet most deployments assume cloud connectivity, and many IoT settings have intermittent, restricted, or no connectivity. We propose a connectivity-regime framework (C0-C4), a taxonomy of inference-time trust mechanisms, and signed, versioned knowledge packs as the update channel for disconnected regimes, and evaluate them on a Raspberry Pi 5 running fully local retrieval-augmented generation under network isolation, with three Qwen2.5 model sizes, three context sizes, and 300 SQuAD 2.0 questions. An empirically calibrated retrieval-score gate detects knowledge gaps almost perfectly (AUROC 0.97) but in-topic unanswerable questions poorly (0.68). translated_title: 面向边缘端离线生成式AI的信任机制：连接状态框架与基于树莓派5的实证研究
translated_abstract: 生成式AI和大语言模型（LLM）正在进入物联网领域，然而大多数部署方案都假设存在云端连接，而许多物联网环境的连接是间歇性的、受限的甚至完全没有连接。我们提出了一个连接状态框架（C0-C4）、一套推理时信任机制的分类体系，以及经过签名和版本化管理的知识包作为断连状态下的更新通道，并在树莓派5上对这些机制进行了评估——该设备在网络隔离条件下运行完全本地的检索增强生成（RAG），实验涵盖三种Qwen2.5模型规模、三种上下文长度以及300个SQuAD 2.0问题。经过实证校准的检索得分门限几乎能够完美地检测知识缺口（AUROC 0.97），但对主题内不可回答问题的检测效果较差（0.68）。确定性输出验证器能够将格式错误的输出转换为显式弃答，且未观察到正确答案的损失，而我们测试的基于自然语言推理（NLI）的验证器几乎没有增益；对于7B模型，96%的子……
tldr: 该论文提出了面向离线/弱连接边缘环境的生成式AI信任机制框架（C0-C4连接状态分类与签名版本化知识包更新通道），并通过树莓派5上的本地RAG实验证明：检索得分门限可近乎完美地检测知识缺口，确定性输出验证器能在不损失正确答案的前提下实现显式弃答。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a connectivity-regime framework (C0-C4) and signed, versioned knowledge packs as trust mechanisms for offline edge generative AI, empirically demonstrating on a Raspberry Pi 5 that a retrieval-score gate detects knowledge gaps (AUROC 0.97) and a deterministic output validator converts malformed outputs into explicit abstentions without losing correct answers.
